description: This file defines a mock class 'GstGenericPlayerPrivateMock' for testing purposes, which inherits from 'IGstGenericPlayerPrivate'. It includes mock methods for various functionalities related to a GStreamer media player, such as scheduling media data, updating caps, changing pipeline state, and attaching media data. The class is part of the 'firebolt::rialto::server' namespace and is used for unit testing within the media playback component.

classes.name: GstGenericPlayerPrivateMock
classes.description: A mock class for IGstGenericPlayerPrivate used in unit testing to simulate media player behavior.

methods.description: Mocks scheduling of media data need for a given GstAppSrc.

methods.description: Mocks scheduling when enough media data is available.
